eoraptor-dawn-dinosaur.description: A slender, long-tailed, two-legged dinosaur with a toothy open jaw and spiky crest-like scales runs at speed across a dry, rocky riverbank in a dim, painterly landscape of ferns, a cliff face and dead branches. A small lizard-like reptile scurries in the lower left, away from its path. Dust and pebbles fly from its feet. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

coelophysis-pack-hunter.description: Three slender, long-necked, long-tailed bipedal dinosaurs run in a line through shallow muddy water at the edge of a dark, fern-filled forest. A fallen mossy log lies across the upper background under a grey, stormy sky. Painterly, dim lighting. No visible text, signature, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.

massospondylus-southern-grazer.description: A long-necked, bipedal-looking dinosaur with a small head, scaly textured skin and sharp claws stands on its hind legs with its long neck arched down toward a nest of speckled round eggs on the ground. Ferns, cycads and dense forest surround it under a dark, stormy sky. Painted in an oil-painting style with warm brown and green tones. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

dilophosaurus-twin-crest.description: A bipedal theropod dinosaur with a tan, scaly body and a fan-shaped orange crest on its head stands in a shallow forest stream, one foot lifted and splashing. Behind it are tall conifers, ferns and a fallen log, under a grey misty sky. No visible text, border or frame.

megalosaurus-great-lizard.description: A large, dark, scaly theropod with a long tail and a crest along its back stands on a muddy shore, mouth open to show serrated teeth. Behind it are araucaria-type conifers, ferns and driftwood, with choppy grey water to the right and a stormy sky. Two long-necked sauropods are faintly visible on the far shore. No text, signature or border is visible, and nothing is bloody.

mamenchisaurus-long-necked-giant.description: A tan-brown sauropod with an extremely long, arched neck stands in a misty forest, its small head at the top of the neck nibbling foliage from a tall conifer with spreading branches. Ferns and cycad-like plants fill the foreground, and a long tail trails at lower left. Painterly, oil-like style, with no visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

brontosaurus-thunder-lizard.description: A large long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail stands in a shallow muddy swamp under a dark, orange-lit storm sky. Conifers stand in the distance, with ferns and palm-like plants in the foreground and mid-ground. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.
